title: [auto-fix] Treat carriage return as ASCII whitespace when splitting.
description:
ByAsciiWhitespace currently searches for space, tab, vertical tab, form feed, and line feed, but omits carriage return despite the documented contract and regression failure. Adding '\r' to its delimiter set fixes the behavior while retaining the existing split logic.

Reproduced failing tests:
- `Split.ByAsciiWhitespace`
